request: How large is the immigration court backlog, and how has it changed?

reply.reply:
At the end of FY2024, the immigration-court backlog stood at 3,558,995 pending cases. That was more than twice the 1.5 million reported in FY2022’s first quarter, showing substantial growth; these are different points in time, not a precise like-for-like growth rate. (CRS IN12492; CRS R47077)

For the verified findings and full citations, see the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-180949-6bdb.html).
reply.reasoning: Presentation verified the end-FY2024 count and historical comparison; the evidence supports substantial growth but not an exact comparable-period rate.
